environment.description: Kubernetes deployment with PostgreSQL 14. The database user 'orderproc' has full DML privileges (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, SELECT) on the 'orders' schema. The HTTP service is exposed via a basic nginx ingress with no additional request filtering. Kafka cluster runs in plaintext mode on the same VPC. Session cookies are set with SameSite=None for cross-subdomain compatibility.

config.db_grants: GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO orderproc
